description.narrative: Belize, HIV, Social Security Board (SSB)This program has the following goals: Deliver tailored combination prevention package of services to MSM, TGs, and their partners.. Strengthen Linkage to Care for persons testing positive for HIV through expanded community outreach and greater engagement of CSOs. Expand treatment coverage for HIV/STIs & TB. Reduce the burden of TB among PLHIV through increased case findings, IPT prophylaxis and enhanced infection control practices. Strengthen advocacy for pro health legislations and initiatives to remove legal, institutional and service delivery barriers.. The objectives of this program are: By 2025, 90% MSM would have had an HIV test in the last 12 months.. By 2025, 90% of PLHIV know their HIV status. By 2025, 90% of PLHIV who know their status are on ARVS.. By 2025, 90% of PLHIV on treatment achieve viral suppression. By 2025, number of AIDS related deaths reduced to less than five.. By 2025, achieve 95% treatment success rate for TB/HIV coinfection.. Achieve zero discrimination in the health care setting by 2025
